# ProofRunner

Independent execution verification for agent-generated software.

## Core

- Inspect repository: POST /api/inspect
- Start verification: POST /api/verify
- Run status: GET /api/runs/{id}
- Receipt JSON: GET /api/receipts/{id}
- Agent skill: /skill.md
- Human interface: /
- Example PASS receipt: /examples/passed
- Example FAIL receipt: /examples/broken

## MVP limitations

- Public GitHub repositories only
- Node.js and TypeScript only
- npm and pnpm only
- No repository secrets
- No user-provided shell commands
